text:
Maria: morning—quick sync on inference-tooling delivery. Where are we on quant recs sign-off and the batching/cache config? Need owners for canary.
Dave: milestone update: quant recs draft done, waiting perf sign-off. Will drop PR today. Owner: @Dave for drafting; needs review.
Hari: infra dependency: perf infra needs a stable dataset (v2) and a slot in nightly; I'm booking a run Thu AM. If anyone needs custom traces, ping me.
Jess: on CRs — I can review Dave's PR but need the quantization matrix and eval rubric. Dave, can you attach?
Dave: attaching link: https://git.redwood/rdw/optkit/pull/412 — quant-matrix.md included. also added example outputs.
Maria: thanks. Acceptance criteria for sign-off: no regression >1% mean-sent-quality on top-20 prompts + latency <10% SLO bump. Agree?
Oliver: FYI we got a regression alert from nightly eval — small token-level drift on summarization set after last merge. Logging here: https://ci.redwood/reports/8793. Could be quantization related.
ci-bot: nightly-eval failed: summary-suite (regression +0.9%). See job: https://ci.redwood/job/summary-suite/8793
Hari: I'll correlate perf traces with model candidate IDs. If it's quant, we may need to tighten calibration or fallback to NQ variant in canary.
Jess: If Oliver can bisect to commit range that'd help. I can land a quick harness to compare float32 vs q4 if we need.
Dave: plan: 1) Oliver bisect 2) Hari run perf with v2 dataset 3) Jess review PR + add q4/float smoke test 4) Maria, finalize canary owners.
Maria: assigning canary rollout owner -> @Jess for initial canary, @Dave for rollback policy. Please ack
Jess: ack. I'll add canary config: route 5% traffic -> candidate, 95% baseline; automatic fallback if regression >0.7% for 3 runs.
Oliver: ack — bisect started, reporting back ~2h.
Maria: great — also log any cost delta for batch/cache changes. Hari, add expected token throughput change to the perf ticket.
Hari: noted, updating ticket #OPT-214 with throughput estimates and cache hit assumptions.
Maria: thanks everyone. We'll reconvene async after Oliver's bisect; if blockers, ping #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
